response.justification: While Bogdan possesses an exceptional technical background with extensive experience in developer tools, testing infrastructure, and software craftsmanship, he lacks the required 2+ years of formal people management experience. Because this is a Level II Manager position heavily focused on full-time people leadership, 1:1s, and performance management, his predominantly Individual Contributor (IC) and technical leadership background makes him a poor fit for this specific role, despite being a potentially excellent Staff/Principal Engineer candidate.
strengths: Extensive 15+ years of software development experience, easily exceeding the 8-year minimum requirement.
Deep domain expertise in engineering productivity, having built testing frameworks (Fluent-Asserts), CI/CD pipelines, and developer tooling.
Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring skills through organizing coding dojos, teaching Selenium courses, and open-source contributions.
concerns: No demonstrated formal people management experience (e.g., direct reports, performance reviews), missing a critical requirement for this Level II Manager role.
Lacks experience leading organizational change at a mid-to-senior management level.
Mobile platform experience is somewhat limited and dated (2015-2016), which may not align with the needs of a modern, large-scale mobile ecosystem.
